title: The package bundle (harness to application seam)
description: The manifest of the package bundle the harness publishes and the application seeds from (blueprint section 9.1); G1 admits a bundle only when every file's SHA-256 matches, every schema validates, the fixture counts match the corpus (98 files, 56 lessons, 211 work orders, the register total), referential closure holds, closed-set bindings are members of their sets, and every quoted span's hash recomputes from the extracted text.

corpus_sha256.description: over sorted relative paths and file digests

extractor.description: exact build string, e.g. "pdftotext version 24.02.0"; the build pinned in this run is 26.02.0 (deviation D-11)

embedding_model.description: null in the bundle; set on the corpus version at seed

path.description: relative path inside the bundle; the frozen tree is BundleLayout

BundleLayout.title: BundleLayout
BundleLayout.description: Every file path of the bundle tree of blueprint section 9.1, relative to bundle/. UNTRACKED in any public repository and produced at seed time from the corpus: chunks.jsonl (it is absent from the released bundle and from the manifest's files list of a public release; the seed job writes it where the corpus exists, ADR-010). Optional (POLISH): simulated/ga-1201a.json. The three contracts/*.schema.json entries are copies of contracts/connectors/ of the harness repository taken at bundle time.

x-file-notes.chunks.jsonl: UNTRACKED in any public repo; produced at seed time from the corpus
x-file-notes.revision_spot.json: one expected (revision, approval_status) tuple per class per asset
x-file-notes.opls.json: parsed lessons: header fields, sections 1 to 6, steps with hashes, troubleshooting rows, footer
